title: Get the results of a split test
content_data:
Use this endpoint at least 24 hours after the test ends to get test results, including p-values for each metric. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/split_test/result/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token{Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | |split_test_group_id {Required} | string | Split test group ID. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/split_test/result/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&split_test_group_id={{split_test_group_id}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number | Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string | Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object| Returned data. | #| split_test_status | string | Status of the split test.
Enum values:
  • `UNKNOWN`: The status of the split test is unavailable.
  • `NOT_STARTED`: The split test has not started because the `start_time` of the split test has not arrived yet.
  • `IN_PROGRESS`: The split test is running.
  • `REPORTING_GENERATING`: The `end_time` of the split test has passed and a report is being generated.
  • `COMPLETED`: The split test either ends automatically, or is manually stopped via [/split_test/end/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1742666522399746).
  • `CANCELLED`: The split test was canceled before the `start_time`. This enum value is only available for campaign level split test.
| #| split_test_level | string |Split test level.
Enum values:
  • `ADGROUP`(Ad group level split test.)
  • `CAMPAIGN`(Campaign level split test.)
| #| object_info | object[] | Information about the two ad groups that are associated with the split test. | ##| adgroup_id | string | Ad group ID. | ##| adgroup_name | string | Ad group name. | ##| optimization_goal | string | Optimization goal of the ad group.
For enum values, see [Enumeration - Optimization Goal](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737174886619138#item-link-Optimization%20Goal). | #| cells | object[] |Cell list of the split test.| ##| object_ids | string[] |List of `campaign_id` or `adgroup_id` in the cell that are associated with the split test.| #| test_variable| string | Split test variable.
Enum values:
  • `BIDDING_OPTIMIZATION`: Set different optimization values for bidding & optimization fields to compare how optimization methods impact your ad performance.
  • `TARGTING`: Set different targeting values at the ad group level for comparing how effective your ad groups are at reaching different audiences or demographics.
  • `CREATIVE`: Set different creatives to compare how different creatives impact your ad performance.
  • `CUSTOM`: Set multiple variables to compare how these variables impact your ad performance. This enum value is only available for campaign level split test.
| #| key_metric | string | The key metric when you created this split test.
If no value is specified for this field, the following default values will be used:
  • For ad group level split test, if both ad groups use `REACH` optimization goal, the default key metric will be `COST_PER_REACH`. Otherwise, the default key metric will be `COST_PER_SHOW`.
  • For campaign level split test, the default key metric is `UNSET`.
| #| start_time | string | The start time of this split test, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (ad account time zone).
Example: `2022-01-01 00:00:00`. | #| end_time | string | The end time of this split test, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (ad account time zone).
Example: `2022-01-01 00:00:00`. | #| p_value_info | object[] | Test result information. | ##| metric | string | Metric name.

  • `UNSET`: Unset.
  • `CONVERT_RATE`: CVR (Conversion rate).
  • `CLICK_THROUGH_RATE`: Click through rate (CTR).
  • `COST_PER_SHOW`: Cost per mille (CPM).
  • `COST_PER_CONVERT`: Cost per conversion.
  • `COST_PER_REACH`: Cost per reach.
  • `COST_PER_CLICK`: Cost per click.
  • `COST_PER_FOCUSED_VIEW`: Cost per focused view.
  • `FOCUSED_VIEW_RATE`: Focused view rate.
  • `COMPLETE_PAYMENT_ROAS`: Complete Payment ROAS.
  • `COST_PER_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`: Cost per landing page view.
  • `LANDING_PAGE_VIEW_RATE`: Landing page view rate.
  • `CLICK`: Click.
  • `REACH`: Reach.
  • `SHOW`: Impression.
  • `CONVERT`: Conversion.
  • `COST`: Cost.
| ##| p_value | float | P value of each metric. There will be a winning ad group or campaign when the p value <= 0.1. | |request_id|string|The log id of the request, which uniquely identifies a request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "key_metric": "FOCUSED_VIEW_RATE", "object_info": [ { "optimization_goal": "FOCUSED_VIEW_RATE", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}" }, { "optimization_goal": "ENGAGED_VIEW_FIFTEEN", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}" } ], "start_time": "{{start_time}}", "test_variable": "BIDDING_OPTIMIZATION", "p_value_info": [], "end_time": "{{end_time}}", "split_test_status": "NOT_STARTED" } } (/code) ```
